info.title: DeviceFlow API
info.description: REST API for DeviceFlow. All paths are relative to /api/v1. Authentication is a session cookie set by POST /auth/login. Every state-changing request must send the header `X-Requested-With: DeviceFlow` (CSRF protection). Errors use one shape: `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`. Operations marked "accepts Idempotency-Key" can be retried safely: send a unique `Idempotency-Key` header (8-128 letters, digits, - or _) per intended change and a repeat returns the saved response with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`.
